name: Limanowa (Poland)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a grey tree between a heraldic mark and a hunting horn, the charge from the city arms.
history: Polish Wikipedia records the first flag of the gmina, of seven horizontal stripes, as established by resolution No. XV/121/95 of 28 September 1995; this file shows the armorial flag with the charge from the arms.

features.role: tree, heraldic mark and hunting horn from the city arms
